_doc: Cross-major overrides accepted on purpose, keyed by package directory (the keys are also the only directories check-override-ranges.mjs runs from). Fields: `override` is the top-level package.json#overrides key (a string-valued key, or a block whose `.` child is the accepted redirect; a key inside a block cannot be accepted); `consumer` the lockfile path that declares the package; `gets` the range the override resolves it to (the override's value); `ghsa` the advisory; `why` the reasoning and the retirement condition. The range mode prints the matching mismatch as `accepted` (exit 0); `--overrides` prints the key `live (accepted …)` while something still declares it and `STALE` once nothing does, for a human to retire with this entry. The scan never edits this file. Tests point the script at their own copy through ACCEPTED_OVERRIDES_FILE. Reasoning: docs/automation/daily-upgrade-scan.md, 'Accepted cross-major overrides'.

backend.why: Every deepmerge-ts below 8.0.0 is vulnerable and no patched 7.x exists; Prisma 7.10.1 itself declares 8.0.2, so the API is compatible. Retire when Prisma is bumped to a release that declares 8.x: that bump turns backend/tests/infra/check-override-ranges.test.ts red (the real-lockfile test expects this accepted line), and the fix is to remove the override, this entry and that test's expectation in the same PR (#890, #923).

mobile.why: Every zod below 4.6.6 is vulnerable (memory exhaustion validating oversized constrained collections) and no patched 3.x exists. @expo/cli 57.0.31 (inside expo, which moves only with a native build) declares ^3.25.76, and every SDK 57 @expo/cli through 57.0.32 still does. Its only zod use is two dev-server schema files (DevToolsPlugin.schema.js, createMCPDevToolsExtensionSchema.js) built from z.object/string/enum/array/union/literal/url/strict and read through safeParse, error.issues and error.message, all present in zod 4; they were exercised against 4.6.7 when this entry was added. One path is untested: with the optional expo-mcp package (not installed here, nor @modelcontextprotocol/sdk), the MCP extension schema is handed to that package's registerTool, which then sees a zod 4 schema. Nothing in the app bundle imports zod. Retire when expo is bumped to a release whose @expo/cli declares zod 4: that bump turns backend/tests/infra/check-override-ranges.test.ts red (the real-lockfile test expects this accepted line), and the fix is to remove the override, this entry and that expectation in the same PR.
